spanish: Y se paró el pueblo desde lejos, y Moisés se acercó a la densura que allí Dios.

findings.issue: densura means thickness or density; הָעֲרָפֶל (H6205) is the dark-cloud/thick-darkness noun, so the darkness is omitted and a generic density is added

notes: Other tokens match: stood, the people, from afar, and Moses approached to where God was; Dios for האלהים is licensed.
